name: hud_ui_panel_rebuild_text_rect
description: HudUiPanel::RebuildTextRect refreshes cached text extents and text image state from the current text, font, wrap, shadow, and color settings.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bac10 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD panel text rendering source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bac10 validates the empty-text cache clear, non-empty GDI measurement, optional word-wrap rect copy, shadow padding, textPick allocation/resizing, pixel clear, GDI text draw/upload/release callbacks, optional gradient recolor through HudUiFlashPanel::ComputeFlashBlendColor, external-leading cache, DeleteDC, and textDirty clear.

The native panel query-text-height smoke constructs a dirty panel, invokes QueryTextHeight through the panel ftable rebuild path, and verifies RebuildTextRect produces positive text metrics, clears the dirty path enough for dependent cached text-height behavior, and leaves GDI font cleanup valid.
